name_input: KADIMI TOOL MANUFACTURING COMPANY PRIVATE LIMITED
note: RISK DATA NOT VERIFIED — research blocked by tooling failure, not by absence of records. All 8 tool calls failed to return usable evidence: web_search returned 'searx: Connection refused' on both queries; DuckDuckGo HTML endpoints timed out; Google returned only a redirect stub; Bing returned corrupted/irrelevant result sets (unrelated celebrity-height and adult-content pages) for both the exact-name and director queries; zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403; tofler.in returned 404 for the guessed slug; a fallback aggregator URL resolved to a parked domain. No sanctions list (OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK, BIS Entity List), no Indian court/party-role record, no regulator action, no credit rating and no Russia/CIS supply evidence could be retrieved or checked. All fields are null because nothing was confirmed — this is NOT a clean bill of health and must not be read as 'no sanctions, no cases'. Note also that the claimed PAN AAACK1016F has a suspicious structure (the 'C' in position 4 denotes a company, but the 5th character 'K' is not a valid PAN surname-initial pattern for a company entity, which normally carries a letter derived from the entity name); this was not verifiable and is flagged only as an observation, not a finding. Recommended action: re-run this company once search infrastructure is restored, checking MCA master data, the OFAC/UN/EU/UK consolidated lists, e-courts/NCLT and CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings directly. No rejection grounds established either way.
